components.name: Button
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use one primary task action per section. Use LinkButton for navigation; label icon-only actions and disable duplicate submissions.

components.name: Calendar
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for explicit date selection. Preserve keyboard movement and distinguish today from the selected day.

components.name: Checkbox
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for independent or multiple choices; associate a visible label and keep selection controlled.

components.name: Comment
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use only for genuine user discussion with author and timestamp; do not repurpose for delivery events.

components.name: Date time picker
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Specify the user timezone, validate future scheduling against API limits, and preserve keyboard entry.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for secondary actions. Keep menu items actionable, label the trigger, and restore focus after dismissal.

components.name: Focus ring
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use supported focusable primitives for new work; preserve visible focus and review the caution notice.

components.name: Form
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Associate labels, validation and helper text with inputs. Keep field errors inline and retain entered values after errors.

components.name: Radio
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for one choice from a visible small set; give the group a label and meaningful option descriptions.

components.name: Range
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use only for approximate values with visible bounds; provide another input when exact values matter.

components.name: Select
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use controlled values and stable option identities. Label the field; handle empty and disabled choices.

components.name: Text area
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for multiline prose or source input; provide an appropriate row count and describe formatting requirements.

components.name: Text field
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use visible labels, meaningful autocomplete and correct input types. Placeholders supplement labels.

components.name: Toggle
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for immediate reversible settings, with a visible label and failure feedback; otherwise use checkbox plus Save.

components.name: Avatar
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Provide the entity name and a fallback. Do not use an avatar alone to communicate permissions.

components.name: Avatar group
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Show relevant people with names available to assistive technology; summarize overflow.

components.name: Icon
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use installed ADS core icons. Hide decorative icons and label icon-only actions.

components.name: Image
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Provide useful alternative text or an empty alternative for decoration; verify light/dark presentation.

components.name: Object
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Reserve Atlassian-specific object assets for their actual meaning; use mail-domain terminology in this product.

components.name: Logo
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Retain mymorphix identity. Do not use an Atlassian logo to imply product ownership or certification.

components.name: Tile
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for a recognizable entity or destination, with a visible label and keyboard-accessible action.

components.name: Badge
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for numeric counts. Expose the associated object and do not imply unread data without a backend count.

components.name: Date label
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Show dates and context accurately; never render a non-interactive date label as an action.

components.name: Lozenge
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use short, textual status labels mapped to actual API states. Color is supplementary; acceptance is not inbox placement.

components.name: Tag
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for object metadata or filtering, keeping any removal action keyboard accessible.

components.name: Tag group
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Keep related tags together and provide a way to inspect overflow rather than silently hiding values.

components.name: Page
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not add the caution-marked layout package. Use the existing semantic Page wrapper and responsive CSS grid.

components.name: Page header
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use the shared Page wrapper with one h1, description and wrapping task actions; titles must handle long content.

components.name: Panel
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for contextual adjacent content with a responsive fallback. Review beta API support before adopting.

components.name: Progress bar
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Show determinate progress only when total work is known; otherwise use an indeterminate loading indicator.

components.name: Skeleton
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not add an early-access dependency just for decoration. Prefer the existing loading state until an API is selected.

components.name: Spinner
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Announce the loading task in a polite status region, and replace it with error or content when complete.

components.name: Banner
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Reserve for workspace-wide actionable conditions. Avoid large repeated informational blocks on every page.

components.name: Empty state
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Distinguish first use, no matching results and permission restrictions. Offer a relevant next action.

components.name: Flag
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use success flags for completed mutations. Persist important failures in the affected view instead of relying only on auto-dismiss.

components.name: Inline message
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Place secondary guidance near the relevant control; do not conceal required instructions in a popup.

components.name: Modal dialog
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Provide a labelled title, focus containment, Escape behavior and focus return. Initial focus for destructive confirmation is Cancel.

components.name: Spotlight
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use current guidance for a specific onboarding task; never block the core task with a marketing tour.

components.name: Section message
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Show local warnings and errors alongside recovery actions; do not use as the default container for ordinary content.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use real parent destinations; the current item is text rather than a fake hash link.

components.name: Link
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use React Router for internal destinations. Describe external destinations and retain native link keyboard behavior.

components.name: Menu
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use structured groups for related actions and preserve keyboard navigation, selection and disabled state.

components.name: Navigation system
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Preferred migration target for a future shell package change. The current shell is custom semantic navigation, not this package.

components.name: Pagination
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use existing server cursors. Never manufacture page totals or page numbers from a single result set.

components.name: Tabs
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for real related views with working data paths; never present unsupported receiving features as functional.

components.name: Blanket
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use only behind an active modal layer; underlying content must not remain keyboard-operable.

components.name: Drawer
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use a labelled mobile dialog with background inertness, focus trap, Escape close and focus restoration.

components.name: Inline dialog
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Avoid new use while marked caution; prefer a supported Popup or a plain adjacent explanation.

components.name: Popup
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for brief anchored interactive content, with dismiss behavior and focus return; do not nest modal workflows.

components.name: Tooltip
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Supplement a visible or accessible label. Never place essential instructions or actionable controls only in a tooltip.

components.name: Overview
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Prefer supported compiled primitives for new work and verify entry points against the pinned installed package.

components.name: Box
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for token-backed containers; retain meaningful semantic elements when they convey structure.

components.name: Inline
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for horizontal related controls, with wrapping on constrained screens.

components.name: Stack
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for vertical flow with spacing tokens instead of child margin overrides.

components.name: Flex
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for one-dimensional responsive layouts; keep DOM and reading order aligned.

components.name: Grid
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for two-dimensional responsive content; minmax(0, 1fr) prevents long text from forcing page overflow.

components.name: Bleed
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use only for intentional container edge alignment; do not hide overflow bugs with negative offsets.

components.name: XCSS
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Existing usage may remain; avoid expanding a caution-marked styling API when a supported alternative is available.

components.name: Responsive
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Test the actual workspace at narrow widths and zoom; hiding the sidebar alone is not responsive behavior.

components.name: Text
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use body text roles and rem-based ADS typography; use secondary small text sparingly.

components.name: MetricText
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use MetricText for dashboard numbers; metrics are not headings.

components.name: Pressable
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use only when a standard Button cannot represent the task; retain native button semantics and focus behavior.

components.name: Anchor
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for custom token-styled links when the standard link cannot fit, with valid href and accessible text.

components.name: Focusable
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use to preserve visible keyboard focus when composing a custom interactive element.

components.name: Progress indicator
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Show position through a short ordered flow; do not treat an arbitrary count as completed progress.

components.name: Progress tracker
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for sequential workflow steps with actual completion state and recovery to unfinished steps.

components.name: Code
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use CodeBlock for examples and identifiers. Never include live secrets in screenshots, examples or documentation.

components.name: Dynamic table
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use the shared Table wrapper with sortable values, cursor pagination, loading/error/empty states and local overflow.

components.name: Heading
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: One h1 per page, then ordered section headings. Visual size does not determine semantic heading level.

components.name: Inline edit
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Provide explicit edit, save and cancel states with validation; preserve the last confirmed value if saving fails.

components.name: Table
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Avoid adding the caution-marked low-level table package. Continue using DynamicTable for ordinary resource lists.

components.name: Table tree
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use only for genuine hierarchical records with meaningful expand/collapse and keyboard behavior.

components.name: Visually hidden
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for context that must remain accessible while hidden visually; never hide focusable actions accidentally.

components.name: CSS
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Evaluate the supported beta package before migrating styling; do not bypass semantic design tokens.

components.name: CSS reset
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Import once at the application entry point, before app styles. Audit global element overrides after changes.

components.name: Design tokens
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use semantic token names, not resolved values. Verify the token exists in the pinned package and every supported theme.

components.name: Entry Points
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Review release status and supported entry paths; do not import internal dist files in production code.

components.name: Motion
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use purpose-driven transitions with reduced-motion support and a static way to understand state.

components.name: Popper
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Prefer a standard dropdown or popup. Use low-level positioning only for an unmet interaction requirement.

components.name: Portal
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not add new direct use of deprecated portal APIs. Let supported overlay components manage layers.

components.name: Pragmatic drag and drop
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Add only for an actual reorder task with persistence and a keyboard alternative.

components.name: App provider
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Keep one app provider and RouterLink integration. Theme initialization must remain centralized.

components.name: ESLint plugin
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Plan the official lint plugin with compatible pinned versions; documenting it does not mean it is installed.

components.name: Storybook addon
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use when Storybook is introduced to review theme variants; do not claim Storybook exists today.

components.name: Stylelint plugin
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use a version-compatible stylelint setup to catch raw and obsolete tokens when introduced.

components.name: UI Styling Standard
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Check current release status and compatibility before adoption; do not add deprecated tooling.

components.name: Atlassian navigation
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not introduce; migrate toward the current navigation-system approach.

components.name: Layout grid
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Use for two-dimensional responsive content; minmax(0, 1fr) prevents long text from forcing page overflow.

components.name: Onboarding (spotlight)
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not introduce the deprecated onboarding package; use current task-focused guidance.

components.name: Page layout
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not introduce; retain the semantic shared shell until a supported navigation migration is reviewed.

components.name: Side navigation
components.detail_status: Index reference; body not exposed in saved HTML
components.implementation_rule: Do not introduce; the dashboard no longer imports this deprecated navigation component.

foundations.name: Tokens
foundations.implementation_rule: Use semantic token names, not resolved values. Verify the token exists in the pinned package and every supported theme.

foundations.name: Accessibility
foundations.implementation_rule: Keep all task flows keyboard-operable, visible focus, semantic landmarks and text labels. Test themes, narrow screens, zoom and errors.

foundations.name: Content
foundations.implementation_rule: Use concise action-first labels, sentence case and specific recovery text. Separate measured delivery outcomes from assumptions.

foundations.name: Spacing
foundations.implementation_rule: Use the ADS spacing scale through tokens. Group related controls with small gaps and separate sections with larger gaps.

foundations.name: Grid
foundations.implementation_rule: Use consistent responsive columns and readable content widths; allow tables to scroll locally.

foundations.name: Color
foundations.implementation_rule: Choose foreground and background by semantic role and theme. Never rely on color alone for status.

foundations.name: Typography
foundations.implementation_rule: Use Heading, Text and MetricText for their respective roles. Preserve rem scaling and one h1 per page.

foundations.name: Motion
foundations.implementation_rule: Use purpose-driven transitions with reduced-motion support and a static way to understand state.

foundations.name: Iconography
foundations.implementation_rule: Use installed ADS core icons. Hide decorative icons and label icon-only actions.

foundations.name: Illustrations
foundations.implementation_rule: Use only when it helps explain an empty or onboarding state; keep decoration secondary to the task.

foundations.name: Logos
foundations.implementation_rule: Retain mymorphix identity. Do not use an Atlassian logo to imply product ownership or certification.

foundations.name: Elevation
foundations.implementation_rule: Match surface background and shadow to the actual layer; use overlay elevation only for temporary layers.

foundations.name: Border
foundations.implementation_rule: Use border width and semantic border tokens for boundaries, selected states and keyboard focus.

foundations.name: Radius
foundations.implementation_rule: Use the installed radius token for each surface and control; do not invent unrelated corner sizes.
